value.rationale: A motivated, complete topology-preservation phase boundary for priced augmentations of any connected tree: all optional edges have independently evaluable sharp prices expressed in cut combinatorics. This avoids solving a full SDP for each candidate topology, identifies exact equality and simultaneous interaction behavior, and generalizes natural network backbone design beyond small named graphs.
